informal_requirement: For one fixed positive real c and each n, maximize the cardinality of a subset of {1,...,floor(c*n)} for which no subset sums to n.

proposed_fragments.parameter_contract: (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) ... (hA : ∀ c n, A n = legacyExtremum c n)
proposed_fragments.intended_candidate_predicate: for every subset C of candidate, n != sum(C)
